The derivative of x² at x = 5.6 is **11.2**.

I loaded Wolfram|Alpha with the query "derivative of x^2 when x=5.6". The result pod shows the input as (dx²)/(dx) where x = 5.6, the result as 11.2, and the general derivative as d/dx(x²) = 2x. Since 2 × 5.6 = 11.2, this matches.
